item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Condense only verified exact duplicates.","mechanism":"Matching file hashes permit grouping; differing license records or creator IDs keep entries separate.","implementation":"Create expandable search groups keyed by hash, license-record ID, and creator ID. Display copy counts and folder paths; retain every file identifier.","check":"Verify same-key copies condense, identical pixels with different licenses remain separate, and every grouped file remains selectable.","risk":"Byte-different encodings remain ungrouped; hash grouping does not establish visual equivalence."},{"action":"Expose intentional version relationships without collapsing variants.","mechanism":"Explicit, typed links distinguish crops and annotations from interchangeable copies without inferring intent from resemblance.","implementation":"Allow people to record directed “crop of” and “annotated version of” links. Show related-version navigation while keeping variants independently searchable.","check":"Link two crops to one original; confirm all three remain independently searchable and links can be corrected or removed.","risk":"Incorrect or incomplete links require human correction; never infer license inheritance."},{"action":"Record the exact licensed file each project used.","mechanism":"An append-only usage record preserves file identity and license context independently of search presentation or later edits.","implementation":"On asset insertion or export, record project ID, file ID, hash, timestamp, and the applicable license-record revision; expose project usage history.","check":"Use identical-pixel files with different licenses in separate projects; verify each history retrieves its actual file and recorded license revision.","risk":"Untracked imports leave gaps; label missing provenance rather than guessing."},{"action":"Precompute grouping metadata outside the search request.","mechanism":"Indexed group keys and counts avoid request-time file inspection or relationship traversal on the first page.","implementation":"Add grouping fields to the existing index. Bound first-page queries; fetch expanded members and relationship details only when opened.","check":"Benchmark the 12,000-asset index under representative concurrency and cold caches; reject deployment if any tested first-page load reaches one second.","risk":"Index capabilities may limit grouping; stale metadata needs reconciliation before release."}],"abstention_reason":""}
